question: LTC vs BCH: larger % price change on July 27, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
QUESTION: Which of Litecoin (LTC) or Bitcoin Cash (BCH) had the larger percentage price change on July 27, 2026, according to CoinGecko's daily historical data?

SETTLEMENT RULES:
1. You are an AI judge settling an information market. Determine the correct outcome using the data provided at the time of settlement.
2. For each token, compute the daily percentage change for July 27, 2026 as: (closing price on July 27, 2026 minus closing price on July 26, 2026) divided by closing price on July 26, 2026, times 100. Use CoinGecko's daily closing prices.
3. Use the exact values shown by CoinGecko.
4. The winning outcome is the coin with the larger (more positive) percentage change. This holds even if both changes are negative — the coin that fell less wins.
5. If the two percentage changes are exactly equal at the precision reported by CoinGecko, resolve to "Litecoin (LTC)".
6. Give your final answer as exactly one of the two outcome labels.

DATA SOURCES: CoinGecko Litecoin Historical Data (https://www.coingecko.com/en/coins/litecoin/historical_data); CoinGecko Bitcoin Cash Historical Data (https://www.coingecko.com/en/coins/bitcoin-cash/historical_data)

POSSIBLE OUTCOMES — select one outcome exactly and output NOTHING else:
Litecoin (LTC)
Bitcoin Cash (BCH)
